title: Merkle Sync Wars
tagline: Compare how five sync strategies reconcile divergent Merkle trees across replicas.

curves.label: Full Hash Flood
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++){sendLeafHash(i); sendSiblingHashes(i);} /* naive full rebroadcast */
curves.name: Full Hash Flood

curves.label: Naive Diff Walk
curves.code: function sync(a,b){for (let i=0;i<n;i++){if (hash(i,a)!=hash(i,b)) mark(i);} requestMarked();} /* linear scan */
curves.name: Naive Diff Walk

curves.label: Logarithmic Proof Match
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++){/* request Merkle proof for mismatched position */ requestProof(i); verifyProof(i);} /* O(log n) per update */
curves.name: Logarithmic Proof Match

curves.label: Batch Range Partition
curves.code: const k = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(n)); for (let r=0;r<k;r++){rangeSync(r*k,(r+1)*k);} /* split into ranges */
curves.name: Batch Range Partition

curves.label: Adaptive Subtree Pruning
curves.code: function prune(node){if (hash(node,a)===hash(node,b)) return; if (node.isLeaf){patch(node);} else {prune(node.left); prune(node.right);} } /* prune matching subtrees */
curves.name: Adaptive Subtree Pruning
